preconditions.description: The number of strings in each sequence is between 1 and 20.
Each string in the sequence s has a length between 1 and 10.
Each string in the sequence t has a length between 1 and 10.
The number of queries is between 1 and 2020.
Each year in the queries is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of strings
postconditions.description: The output should be a list of strings, each representing the name of the year according to the Gapja system.

invariants.expression: output[i] is the concatenation of s_j and t_k for some j and k
invariants.description: The name of each year is formed by concatenating a string from s and a string from t, in order.

invariants.expression: if j reaches n, it wraps around to 1
invariants.description: When the end of a sequence is reached, the indexing wraps around to the beginning.

invariants.expression: if k reaches m, it wraps around to 1
invariants.description: When the end of a sequence is reached, the indexing wraps around to the beginning.
